get_free_loopback_tcp_port: get a free IPv6 loopback TCP port and its address string for gRPC testing
create_dummy_channel: create a dummy gRPC insecure channel bound to a free loopback port
perform_unary_unary_call: perform a unary-unary gRPC call with optional wait-for-ready flag on a channel
perform_unary_stream_call: perform a unary-stream gRPC call and iterate over all responses from the server
test_call_wait_for_ready_enabled: test that all gRPC call types wait for server readiness before failing
